name: oshpark
label: OSH Park
notes: Bare boards only (OSH Park does not assemble). Checked against docs.oshpark.com on 2026-11-09: 2-layer prototype service 6 mil (0.1524 mm) track and space, 10 mil (0.254 mm) drill, 5 mil (0.127 mm) annular ring, 15 mil (0.381 mm) board-edge keepout; 4-layer service 5 mil (0.127 mm) track and space, 10 mil drill, 4 mil (0.1016 mm) annular ring, same edge keepout. Its KiCad guide recommends Gerber X2, the layers listed here (paste optional), drill origin absolute, decimal zeros, alternate oval mode. UNVERIFIED: silkscreen minimums (0.8 mm / 0.15 mm used), hole_to_hole, hole_clearance, npth_min, and that PTH and NPTH should be merged into ONE drill file (the guide does not say; Copper merges them). OSH Park also accepts the .kicad_pcb file directly, which avoids every Gerber setting.
order_notes: Order: upload the zip (or the .kicad_pcb itself) at oshpark.com and check every layer in the upload preview; boards come bare, so assembly=true only writes a BOM and a position file for your own use
